judgment.reason: The invoked Beatty-difference bound is essentially the desired assertion in greater generality and is not proved; the following sketch does not establish its disjointness or counting claims.
The lemma is unproved. Translates need only be disjoint from B, not from one another, and the stated interval-counting implication is asserted without a valid argument.
It relies on an unproved lemma, and its claimed consequence from fractional-part gap bounds to a local three-element bound is unsupported and does not follow as stated.
The translate argument does not imply the asserted bound on consecutive elements of B. Moreover, the inequality 4N/floor(sqrt N)+2 <= 4sqrt N+2 is generally reversed.
